Name: Phone Number
Description: The telephone number for the person

Name: Unknown patient
Description: Used to flag patients that cannot be identified during the check-in process

Name: Next of Kin Name
Description: Name of patient's next of kin / relative

Name: ABHA Verified
Description: Whether this patient's demographics were KYC-verified against their ABHA. Set by hisp_india_core from a server-side verification draft only - never accepted from a client payload, since the D9 field lock is built on it. Cleared by an audited override.

Name: ABHA Verification Mode
Description: How the ABHA was verified: AADHAAR_OTP, MOBILE_OTP or DEMOGRAPHIC. Different modes carry different confidence.

Name: ABHA Verified On
Description: Timestamp of the ABHA verification that produced the current demographics.

Name: ABHA Verified Demographics
Description: Canonical fingerprint (given|middle|family|gender|yyyy-MM-dd) of the demographics as verified against ABHA. Read and written only by AbhaDemographicsFingerprint. Exists because an old-vs-new comparison inside a save advice cannot work - Hibernate hands the advice the already-mutated instance - so the invariant is recorded at verification time instead. Voided when an authorised override changes the demographics.
